_readme: Per-task AI configuration for Card Crafters.

Each task has: primary model, fallback models (tried in order after the primary's retries are exhausted), temperature, maxTokens, timeoutMs, retries, and an optional structured-output schema name from @cardcrafters/shared.
mode 'auto' = use OpenRouter iff OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set, otherwise the deterministic mock provider (full game runs on mock).
ENV OVERRIDES (applied by loadTaskConfig at startup, take precedence over this file):
AI_MODE                    mock | openrouter | auto (default auto)
AI_BUDGET_PER_GAME_USD     number, per-game AI spend ceiling (default 50; mock calls cost 0)
AI_TASK_<NAME>_MODEL       override the primary model, e.g. AI_TASK_PROMPT_VALIDATION_MODEL=google/gemini-3.8-flash
AI_TASK_<NAME>_FALLBACKS   override fallbacks, comma-separated, e.g. AI_TASK_ITEM_IMAGE_FALLBACKS=google/gemini-3.1-flash-image,google/gemini-3-pro-image
<NAME> is the task key upper-snake-cased: prompt_validation -> AI_TASK_PROMPT_VALIDATION_*, item_image -> AI_TASK_ITEM_IMAGE_*.
MODEL LIFECYCLE (audited Nov 2026 — all models below have published retirement dates past March 2027,
except openai/gpt-6-luna which is Active with no announced retirement; it is OpenAI's designated
replacement for the retired gpt-4.1-mini line):
google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite   text   retires 2027-07-21 or later
google/gemini-3.8-flash        text   retires 2027-09-02 or later
openai/gpt-6-luna              text   active, no announced retirement
google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image  image  retires 2027-06-28 or later
google/gemini-3.1-flash-image  image  retires 2027-05-28 or later
google/gemini-3-pro-image      image  retires 2027-05-28 or later
RETIRED (never re-add): openai/gpt-image-1 (shut down 2026-10-23), openai/gpt-4.1-mini and
openai/gpt-4o-mini (shut down 2027-01-14), google/gemini-2.5-flash (reroutes 2026-12-01),
google/gemini-2.5-flash-image (retires 2027-03-15), openai/gpt-5-image-mini (unconfirmed, 'not sooner than 2026-12-01').
maxTokens 0 means 'omit max_tokens' (used by the image task).
